about: Claude Code's screens (capture-pane -p -J), from main's tests/captain_screens.py and tests/screens/: runner2's captures of a real Claude Code 2.1.282 (board 13265, PR #224) and the shapes the captain's reader is pinned on. Each dialog's prompt is [shape, yes_key, no_key] as capabilities.screen_prompt reads it; on its permission chooser and trust dialog the letter y does nothing, the digit 1 (Yes) does. A screen marked ready is one capabilities.ready_on_screen (or its default) reads as ready for a typed line; every other is not.
